evidence.title: PawPort - SG Pet Care & Vets App - App Store

name: PawPort - SG Pet Care & Vets
summary: Pet care app for Singapore: health records, vaccination reminders, HDB breed checker and licence helper.
description: A pet care app built for Singapore dog and cat owners: one pet health record with vaccination reminders, an HDB breed checker for adoption, an AVS pet licence (PALS) checklist covering microchip and Pet Ownership Course steps, and help finding the nearest 24-hour emergency vet. Free on the App Store (Lifestyle), by Signer Labs.
contains: pet health records and vaccination reminders
HDB breed checker for dog adoption
